g.title: TOP — s(11) = s-hat, equality only for Trump mod G (S1) [open] The composed theorem. Open until every 'open' descendant below closes.
A.D1 — Attainment: s(11) is a minimum (D1) [proved-prose] Compactness; two paragraphs. Formalisation cost: closedness of Fits.
A.PARAM — Every packing is represented in (cx,cy,t), t in [0,1] [open] Elementary but load-bearing for EVERY certificate family; same lemma the measure bridge (F2) needs. Never written out.
A.LB382 — Theorem 1: s(11) >= 3.82 [certificate+verifier] Two independent exact verifiers (verify_measure.py; Lean checkMeasureI via native_decide). Bridge lemma is A.F2.

A.S3 — s-hat is THE octic root (isolation certificate) [certificate+verifier] DISCHARGED (A63). The octic has exactly 2 real roots; the one in [3.877083, 3.877084] is the second; all Taylor coefficients at the left endpoint above degree 0 are positive, so the Lean uniqueness proof is calculus-free. 5 corruption gates fail as required.

A.UBshat — Upper bound AT s-hat exactly (Trump's packing exists at s-hat) [open] ROUTE DECIDED (A63, docs/proofs/attainment_ub.md): route (b) (Fits-closed + certificate sequence) REFUTED as a finite route (scaling breaks unit squares; rational curves have rational sigma-limits). Route (a) already certifies Fits(s_A22) (A22 feasibility, Python-interval TCB); residue = the algebraic identity s_A22 = s-hat, pinned to 2.1e-47 by T1's Taylor bound; closure specs: exact number-field verification (compositum deg <= 56 - a coordinate has a degree-7 minimal polynomial, so the field is NOT Q(s-hat)) or the S3-fallback restatement with s-hat := s_A22.

A.UNIQ — Uniqueness transfer: EVERY packing at s-hat reaches a stratified representative mod G [open] RE-DIAGNOSED (A63, docs/proofs/unique_transfer.md): the axiom AS STATED follows from census exhaustiveness (A53 L3); the hole moved into stratum_kill's forall-packings quantifier at the K1-protected classes. Full architecture on file: CC-2 teleport chain to a stuck packing + stuck-kills (H10-stuck) + residual/basin + COLLAPSE back via Theorem U (node A.THMU). Obligations U-O1..U-O4.

A.SBRIDGE — Lemma B: interior-disjoint packings vs closed-disjoint certificate families (lambda-dilation with pin slack, S4/F9) [proved-prose] The bridge applied at EVERY kill use; corpus containment margin rho = 73787046228886605157/73786980692884783104003906250 ~ 1.0000009e-9, exactly positive, uniform over all 68 kill certificates. Also closes the same gap for lb_382 (r = 0 case). A60 feedback round: Lemma B-NO (B.2'') added for nofams certificates (A60 confinement leaves) - occupancy transfers with the zone contracted by 1/lambda, consumers widen outward; owner-frame (H) criterion (B.2') codifies the tilted-core rho false alarm; rho independently reproduced by A60 on 49 leaves.

A.THMU — Theorem U: one-square rigidity of z-hat (11 re-insertion certificates) [open] NEW LEAF (A63): the single new mathematical ingredient of the uniqueness clause; executable spec (case-LP at a rational side in T1's isolating interval, 10 shrunk cores, budget 1, nofams zone inside the basin box).

B.SEL — Selection: a k-maximal slide-stuck minimiser exists (H1 / L6 / CC-2) [proved-prose] CAVEAT (H1): degenerate slide cases (slide creating a contact mid-way, ties, sigma-changing slides) not written; not in docs/proofs/.

B.CENSUS — Census: skeleton classes are exhaustive (1110 tuples / 163 D4 classes) [certificate+verifier] Exact Fractions enumeration, D4-reduced, Trump canary. CAVEAT (H2): ONE implementation; independent re-enumeration + diff still owed. The Young-form definition is also the depgraph's biggest DEFINITIONAL debt: InStratum is opaque in the Lean statement.
B.K1 — K1: kills climb containment, aliveness descends (H3) [proved-prose] Now has a docs/proofs home with both directions proved (kills climb, aliveness descends via witness adjunction).

B.EXACT — Exact-skeleton vs pin-monotone bridge [proved-prose] CLOSED for the certified part (A63): exactly => contains is reflexivity + D4 bookkeeping; the certificate's monotone form is strictly stronger. The K1-protected tier is deliberately out of scope - that is H10, target form H10-stuck.

C.WIN — Window transfer: every kill valid on all of [3.82, s-hat] (H6) [certificate+verifier] PARTIAL: 38/52 strata full-window; 12 s0-only (A61 running); 2 partial slivers (k6_23, k6_07); A57 sub-tree kills s0-only. A56 REFUTED transfer-as-a-principle, so this cannot be factored out as a single lemma â€” it is a per-certificate obligation, which is why the Lean axiom fuses it into stratum_kill (findings F6). A63: the S4 application step (kill at the minimiser's own side) is now the WRITTEN Lemma B/B-prime of docs/proofs/closed_disjoint_bridge.md; full-window parametric coverage + dense rationals instantiate stratum_kill at every m in [3.82, s-hat] for covered classes.
C.K61 — 61 pin-set kill certificates (k=3: 1, k=4: 8, k=5: 19, k=6: 33) [certificate+verifier] All exact, independently re-verified, corruption-gated. At s0; window coverage tracked at C.WIN.

C.A57 — k5_11 + k5_16 killed by sub-stratification trees [certificate+verifier] CAVEAT: s0-only (the sub-tree kills have no parametric window form yet); pinguard soundness gate closed the A54 substrat.py gap (H5). A63 SHARPENING (closed_disjoint_bridge B.3): with the library's eps-fat pin cores (margin ~1e-9) an s0-only certificate reaches only a ~4e-10-relative shell below s0, i.e. NO side of [3.82, s-hat]; upgrade = parametric tree or slack-core fixed-side grid (B.4). A63 follow-up: cover-invariance lemma PROVED (docs/proofs/cover_invariance.md) - the parametric route is theory-open; residue = 601 logic-kill C-checks + make_param/verify_param tool gaps + one 4D pass; slack-core grid (delta 1e-2, ~8 days, T21) is the measured alternative; routes compose per leaf. LIVE 2026-09-02: window campaign G1 RUNNING (4-side slack-core grid delta=1e-2 covering [3.81794, s0] with 95%-overlap slabs, V9/E4 gate clean; parametric skip-list as upside; first 4D window-wide PASS achieved on an eps_geo-repaired leaf; est 6.4 desktop-days, 4-5 w/ skip list).

C.K4TIER — k<=4 / k<=3 tier exclusion (H10) [open] THE LARGEST OPEN LEAF. K1-protected classes ({k4_03,k4_05,k4_06,k4_08,k4_11,corners4} + ten k<=3) can never be killed by pin certificates (A55 sharpness); exclusion must come from skeleton maximality. A58 delivered CC-2 and the 2-crowd theorem; the residue is 'a crowd-pricing problem' with no executed route.
C.CC2 — CC-2/CC-2' exchange (teleport) lemma + clear-corner 2-crowd [proved-prose] Subsumes A53 L6. Trump is teleport-extremal (canary). Feeds C.K4TIER, does not close it.
C.T5T11 — Logic-kill rules T5/T11 (+ pinguard semantics) [proved-prose] H5: the A54 unsoundness is fixed and gated, but the fix is a code invariant + notes, not a standalone lemma document.
C.M1 — M1: single-corner pin-sets transfer down the window free [proved-prose] Covers 4 classes.
C.A61 — 12 s0-only strata + 2 sliver bands [open] Bounded compute per A56's recipe, not theory.
D.TREE — trump5 residual: zone-tree discharges the stratum into the basin [open] GO-priced finite program; every kill an exact certificate. Open until the campaign closes; window form is D.SLAB.
D.N1 — N1: zone-assignment collapse (occupancy pigeonhole) [proved-prose] PROVED; H1-style machine-checked component in exact rationals.

D.TRAP — Upward trap: all six one-cell Young completions of trump5 certified empty [certificate+verifier] Drain cannot escape upward at s0; window form = A56's six-class ticket (partially open, see C.WIN).
D.P1 — A59-P1: trump5 packings have a square centred in [1.1,2.777]^2 [certificate+verifier] Exact cert, re-verified depth 60.

D.LADDER — Residue ladders terminate into the basin (depth-2/3 conditioning) [open] H11 SUSPECT #1 (was 'extrapolated'). The A60 falsifier VINDICATED the suspicion: at A59's basin radius the ladders DIVERGE (18->620 boxes); they terminate only at the corrected conditioning radius r=4.45e-4 (level 24, 15-35 boxes, all inside the basin). Now measured, not extrapolated; still open until the full campaign closes. Also G-A60-2: the zone-cover route is dead for the outer squares; confinement is the verified fix.

D.ALIVE — alivewitness: exact disjoint-family bound tau* >= budget [certificate+verifier] The ALIVE-side arbiter; strict positive gaps in exact rationals. Carries the load G-A59-12 would otherwise carry.

D.SLAB — Low-s slab / window form of the residual (H7, G-A59-7) [open] Packings with sigma well below s0 inside trump5 are invisible at fixed-s nodes; the residual tree's (K) leaves need their A56-parametric overhead. The Lean axiom trump_residual quantifies over the whole window, which makes this hole explicit. A63: the dilation bridge transfers KILLS only, never the containment conclusion (pulled-back basin box misses InBasin by ~(lambda-1)|c|); slab remains open; slack-core grid named as the cheapest route. Slack-core grid pricing HELD: A60's measured certification law is eta <= -1 (0.5-slack regime failed on trump5); delta=1e-3 re-emission test in flight.

D.D4 — D4 reduction machine-checked at the working side (H12) [open] Machine-checked at 3.84; the s0 re-run is 'mechanical' but NOT DONE. The residual tree's mod-G bookkeeping (and the f, e produced by trump_residual) rest on it.

D.S6 — S6: residue boxes land inside the basin in ALL 33 coordinates [open] Measured at conditioning depth 3; the composed containment statement (mod G, all coordinates) is what trump_residual's InBasin conclusion needs in writing.

D.TAUK — G-A59-12: tau* = k on Trump-adjacent boxes [conjecture] H11 SUSPECT #2. VERDICT: MOTIVATION-ONLY. The load-bearing direction (tau* >= k, which blocks certificates) is witness-certified per node by D.ALIVE; the conjectured equality only informed pricing.
A.F2 — Measure bridge: checker PASS => mu(Q)>=1 for all Q => no packing [proved-prose] Prose only; Lean formalisation estimated 3-5 days (A28 notes 7 item 4).

V.MEAS — verify_measure.py soundness (+ Lean checkMeasureI evaluation) [proved-prose] Exact integer B&B; Lean proves the checker evaluates true (native_decide); soundness argument prose. Two independent implementations EXIST for this family (C3 done here only).

V.CASE — verify_case.py soundness (PASS => no packing satisfies the pin hypotheses) [proved-prose] Single implementation (C3 OPEN â€” decides the optimality tree); spec frozen by A62 as docs/specs/case_lp_certificate_v1.md.

V.PARAM — verify_param.py soundness (P0-P7) [proved-prose] Imports the audited A53 integer core unmodified; new predicates are point->interval widenings (conservative direction argued in prose). Single implementation.
E.A36 — Basin theorem: sigma >= s-hat on box(z-hat, 3.7e-3), equality iff z-hat [certificate+verifier] Stratum-blind, all break sets, both FJ branches; x7.5 the A22 radius.
E.A22 — Krawczyk: unique contact solution z-hat, feasible, strict local optimality [certificate+verifier] Also the natural carrier of A.UBshat (existence + feasibility of the exact packing at s-hat).

E.COORD — Basin box in t-coordinates (theta -> t re-emission) [proved-prose] HALF-CLOSED (A63): exact Lipschitz constants |dt| <= |dtheta| <= 2|dt|; rBasin = 3/2000 now a Lean DEFINITION, justified including the forall-s slab via the corner-perturbation bound r(1+sqrt2) < 37/10000. Residue: the t-reparametrised re-emission of the A22/A36 certificates (trust-chain item, = checklist F6 / E.IV), not a radius question any more.

E.IV — mpmath.iv validated interval arithmetic [cited] Third-party library inside the rigidity trust chain (unlike the case-LP chain, which is stdlib-only). Checklist F6: either replay in Lean via t-parametrisation or disclose as Python-interval-only.

X.IL19 — I-L19 flush-mandatory (global-realizability form) [conjecture] H11 SUSPECT #3. VERDICT: OFF-TREE / MOTIVATION-ONLY. The A46-A51 flush-free program fed census design for the ABANDONED enumerate-then-solve routes; no leaf of the live stratification composition invokes it. (If the k<=3 route ever reaches for the A46/A48/A50 toolkit, its lemmas apply only under flush-free hypotheses â€” re-run this sweep then.)

X.S3BDBFS — Seam S3: BDBFS/atlas discovery-loop termination (empirical) [conjecture] H11 SUSPECT #4. VERDICT: OFF-TREE. It belonged to the superseded T0/A38 far-field composition. The live plan discharges trump5 into the A36 basin only; atlas completeness and loop termination are not invoked by any live leaf.
X.ATLAS — CP-atlas completeness (36 entries = all attractors) [conjecture] OFF-TREE for the composition (A51-NEW-0 showed it incomplete and it did not matter). Used as a map, never as a premise.
X.CSTAR — A44 C* / C-rep (FJ counting bounds) [conjecture] OFF-TREE: census-pricing only, for routes not taken.
X.GA531 — G-A53-1 s-monotonicity of kills [conjecture] SUPERSEDED, deliberately unused: A56's adopted form is parametric verification precisely so that monotonicity is never assumed. No live edge.
